source: 652 “Extreme Joy Begets Sorrow”
target: 652 “Extrema Laetitia Tristitiam Parit”

source: Upon hearing Lumian’s question, Hisoka’s lips curved into a smile.
target: Quaestionem Lumiani audita, labia Hisokae in risum curvaverunt.

source: “Those are a few Fallen, under my control.”
target: “Hi sunt pauci lapsi, sub mea potestate.”

source: “Fallen?”
target: “Lapsi?”

source: Lumian could understand the literal meaning, but he didn’t grasp the situation.
target: Lumian sensum litteralem intellexit, sed rem non comprehendi potuit.

source: Simultaneously, he criticized Hisoka.
target: Simul, Hisokam reprehendit.

source: This is truly a dream.
target: Hoc vere somnium est.

source: Emotions change so quickly.
target: Affectus celeriter mutantur.

source: Hisoka reminisced, “A Desire Apostle can plant a seed in others’ hearts when their emotions and desires clearly fluctuate, causing corresponding problems to worsen.
target: Hisoka rememoravit, “Apostolus Desiderii semen in corda aliorum inocere potest, cum eorum affectus et desideria manifeste fluctuant, causantes ut problemata correspondentia peiorentur.

source: Gradually, they lose control and degenerate.”
target: Gradatim, potestate sua destituuntur et degenerantur.

source: “When combined with my special abilities, I can make those humans unable to escape my control and obey only me for a long period through repeated depravities.”
target: “Cum meis facultatibus specialibus coniunctis, eos homines facio ut e mea potestate effugere non valeant et mihi soli diu pareant per scelera repetita.”

source: It’s akin to injecting addictive psychiatric drugs, but more mystical?
target: Hoc simile est infusioni medicamentorum psychotroporum addictorum, sed magis mysticum?

source: Lumian searched for analogous examples from an easy-to-understand perspective.
target: Lumian quaesivit exempla analogia ex perspectiva facili intellectu.

source: Suddenly, he recalled Naboredisley’s description of Demons: “Demon in body, Demon in mind…”
target: Subito, recoluit descriptionem Naboredisley de daemonibus: “Daemon in corpore, daemon in mente…”

source: Could this be a manifestation of the Demon within the mind?
target: Numquid hoc manifestatio daemonis in mente est?

source: Is Hisoka’s distinctiveness reflected in this aspect?
target: Num singularitas Hisoka in hoc aspectu exprimitur?

source: Could it be that the individual from the temperance faction liaising with him has been tainted by his influence, causing them to withhold reporting any irregularities?
target: Num fortasse persona ex factione temperantiae, quae cum eo operatur, a eius influxu corrumpitur, ita ut ne ullam irregularitatem referat?

source: Lumian gazed thoughtfully at Hisoka and inquired, “Indeed, as one would expect from an Apostle of Desire, a Demon that seduces the darkness of the mind.
target: Lumian cogitato vultu ad Hisokam respexit et quaesivit, “Profecto, sicut ab Apostolo Desiderii exspectatur, daemon qui tenebras mentis seducit.

source: Is this a ritual for ascending to a Demon?”
target: Num hic ritus est ad daemon ascendendum?”

source: “Just acclimating for now,”
target: “Modo solum consuescens.”

source: Hisoka didn’t refute, yet he sensed the current situation was far from ideal. It felt more like a rehearsal.
target: Hisoka non refutavit, sed sensit rem praesentem longe non esse idealem; magis ut exercitationis similis videbatur.

source: “You seem quite assured.”
target: “Videtur te esse satis certum.”

source: Following the incident in Tizamo Town at year’s end, you likely ascended to a Desire Apostle.
target: Post rem in oppido Tizamo ad finem anni, verisimiliter ad Apostolum Desiderii ascendisti.

source: It’s only been a year, and you’re already contemplating becoming a demigod?
target: Nondum enim annus oblatus est, et iam meditatus es de te fieri semideo?

source: Lumian mused briefly before questioning,
target: Lumian paulum meditatus, deinde quaesivit:

source: “Is it because you finally appeased that Demon from the Nois family and acquired that thing?”
target: “Num propterea, quod tandem illum daemonem ex familia Nois placasti et illud adeptus es?”

source: Even in his reverie, Hisoka appeared hesitant to disclose this matter.
target: Etiam in somnio suo, Hisoka dubitans hanc rem enarrare videbatur.

source: He responded with a hint of reluctance, “Yes.”
target: Responsum dedit modico reticentiae signo: “Ita.”

source: Lumian refrained from provoking Hisoka for the time being, ensuring the dream didn’t end prematurely.
target: Lumian interim, a Hisoka provocando abstinuit, curans ne somnium praetempore finiretur.

source: He altered his question.
target: Quaestionem mutavit.

source: “Where is that thing?”
target: “Ubi est illud?”

source: When Hisoka transformed into a Devil, his attire ruptured, and nothing unusual dropped.
target: Cum Hisoka in Diabolum transformatus est, vestitus eius ruptus est, nec quidquam insolitum cecidit.

source: Hisoka’s countenance contorted as he responded, “I-in Tizamo Town.”
target: Vultus Hisokae contortus est, et respondit, “In oppido Tizamo.”

source: Concealed in his body’s hometown, Tizamo Town… If it’s significant, why doesn’t he carry it with him?
target: In oppido natali corporis eius, oppido Tizamo, celatum est… Si grave est, cur illud secum non fert?

source: Lumian’s curiosity about the two pranks orchestrated by Hisoka in Tizamo Town and the gold mine city, Devise, intensified.
target: Curiositas Lumiani de duobus iocis Hisoka in oppido Tizamo et in urbe fodinae auri, Devise, magis ac magis augebatur.

source: After a brief pause of contemplation, Lumian inquired, “You staged a prank in Devise just to pilfer a batch of gold?”
target: Post breve moram meditationis, Lumian quaesivit, “Iocum in Devise fecisti ut tantum copiam auri furarer?”

source: “Yes,” Hisoka affirmed.
target: “Ita,” confirmavit Hisoka.

source: Have you consumed too many novels like the Gold Heist? Were you in dire need of such a large sum of money back then?
target: Num nimis multas novellas quales “Gold Heist” legis? Erasne tempore illo in magna pecuniae copia vehementer indigens?

source: Yes, for criminals, it’s quite normal to plan an operation to snatch gold when necessary.
target: Ita, criminis consuetum est operatio constituere ad aurum rapiendum, cum opus est.

source: Unlike me, who relies on hunting and the gifts of villains… Just as Lumian thought it was trivial, he suddenly considered something.
target: Contra me, qui in venatione et donis pravorum confido… Sicut Lumian id parvum putavit, subito aliquid meditatus est.

source: Franca has been accumulating gold for future sacrifices to the Armored Shadow, Chen Tu…
target: Franca aurum colligit pro futuris sacrificiis ad Umbram Loricatum, Chen Tu…

source: Could Hisoka have orchestrated a prank to obtain a substantial amount of gold for a similar sacrifice?
target: Num Hisoka iocum composuisse potuit ut quantam aurum pro simili sacrificio adipisceretur?

source: Lumian scrutinized Hisoka and probed, “Did you offer the gold as a sacrifice to the Nois family’s Demon?”
target: Lumian Hisokam diligenter examinavit et inquisivit, “Num aurum pro sacrificio ad daemonem familiae Nois obtulisti?”

source: Hisoka replied nonchalantly, “In Tizamo Town.”
target: Hisoka levi animo respondit: “In oppido Tizamo.”

source: “What’s in Tizamo Town?” Lumian asked.
target: “Quid in oppido Tizamo est?” quaesivit Lumian.

source: Hisoka appeared to snap out of his daze and exclaimed with a contorted expression, “Dream Festival, Dream Festival!”
target: Hisoka ex stupore evigilare videtur et, vultu contorto, exclamavit, “Festum Somniorum, Festum Somniorum!”

source: His shadow surged to life, leaping onto him and shrouding him.
target: Umbra eius in vitam exsurrexit, in eum saltans et eum tegens.

source: Hisoka reverted to pitch-black, transforming into a viscous, repulsive, and malevolent liquid that spread swiftly in all directions, as if determined to corrupt the interrogation room, Lumian, and the entire dream.
target: Hisoka in atrum purum rediit, transformatus in liquidum viscosum, abjectum, et maleficum, quod celeriter in omnes partes se diffudit, quasi ad cellam interrogationis, Lumian, et totum somnium corrumpendum destinatus.

source: Lumian promptly exited the dream and observed Hisoka, who lay asleep on the ground, displaying signs of Devilification once more.
target: Lumian celeriter ex somnio exiit et Hisokam observavit, qui in terra dormiens iacebat, iterum signa diabolica ostendens.

source: Furthermore, he seemed somewhat translucent.
target: Praeterea, paulo translucens videbatur.

source: This key member of April Fool’s was teetering on the brink of losing control!
target: Hic membrum praecipuus “Aprilis Stultorum” in limine imperii amittendi vacillabat!

source: Without hesitation, Lumian materialized a longsword crafted from blazing white flames in his hand.
target: Sine mora, Lumian gladium longum ex flammarum alborum fulgentium in manu sua evocavit.

source: The Hisoka figure before him emitted a myriad of colors, with the pale-white mark on the bridge of his nose being the least conspicuous.
target: Figura Hisoka ante eum innumeros colores emittens erat, cum signum pallide albo in ponte nasi eius minimum conspicuum appareret.

source: Weakness Investigation!
target: Investigatio infirmitatis!

source: Paleness signified a vulnerability.
target: Pallor vulnerabilitatem significabat.

source: Lumian hoisted the flaming sword, gripping it with both hands, and thrust downward, vanishing into the pale-white hue.
target: Lumian gladium flammantem, manibus utrisque prehensum, tollit atque deorsum impulit, evanescens in pallide-albo nitore.

source: The Devil-like armor, resilient flesh, and steel-like bones bestowed by Zombie endured only a second before being pierced.
target: Lorica Diabolica, caro robusta, et ossa ferri similia a Zombie data, solummodo tempore uno sustinuerunt antequam perforata sint.

source: Lumian withdrew his blazing-white flaming sword and thrust down again.
target: Lumian gladium albo flammantem retraxit et iterum deorsum impulit.

source: Pfft!
target: Pfft!

source: This time, it penetrated deeper.
target: Hoc tempore penitus intravit.

source: Lumian extracted the blazing-white flaming sword once more and leaped up, adding his weight to the downward thrust.
target: Lumian gladium albo flammantem iterum extraxit et salivit, pondus suum in impetum deorsum addens.

source: Pfft!
target: Pfft!

source: Lumian genuflected, and the flaming sword plunged into Hisoka’s brain, transforming into scattered flames that obliterated all weakness.
target: Lumian genu flectit, et gladium flammantem in cerebrum Hisokae immergit, transformans in flammas dispersas qui omnem infirmitatem exstinxerunt.

source: Lumian withdrew his hands and stood up.
target: Lumian manus removit et surrexit.

source: Hisoka’s body, displaying signs of Devilification, twitched a few times before settling.
target: Corpus Hisokae, signa diaboli effectus exhibens, aliquoties concussit antequam quietum statuit.

source: Adjacent to the bridge of his nose, a two-finger-wide wound appeared grotesquely abnormal.
target: Juxta pontem nasi eius, vulnus duorum digitorum latum, deformiter insolutum apparuit.

source: Its surface was charred and contracted, while flames surged from within.
target: Superficies eius ustulata et contracta erat, cum flammas ex intimo erumpere videbantur.

source: The Devil had lost his life.
target: Diabolus vitam amisit.

source: How resilient. He managed to withstand three strikes like this…
target: Quam validus! Tale trium ictuum tolerare potuit…

source: Lumian gazed at Hisoka’s corpse and silently sighed.
target: Lumian cadaver Hisokae respexit et tacite suspiravit.

source: In that moment, Hisoka’s corpse swiftly turned transparent, and his light brown skin gradually faded to pale-white.
target: In illo momento, cadaver Hisokae celeriter transparentem factum est, et cutis eius, luce fusca, paulatim in pallidum album decoloravit.

source: Wraith… Transforming into a genuine wraith after death?
target: Umbra… Fieri umbra vera post mortem?

source: Just as these thoughts crossed Lumian’s mind, his surroundings abruptly darkened.
target: Simul cum haec cogitationes in mente Lumiani pertransibant, ambitus eius subito obscurati sunt.

source: In the depths of the darkness, a serene chant resonated, soothing one’s body and mind, inducing a reluctance to do anything but lie still.
target: In profundis tenebrarum, tranquillus cantus resonavit, corpus et animam leniens, et impellens ut nihil ageret nisi quiescere.

source: All escape was tranquility.
target: Tranquillitas erat omnis fuga.

source: Hisoka’s wraith form halted its transformation, gradually gaining a tangible quality.
target: Forma umbratile Hisokae transformationem sistit, paulatim qualitatem tangibilem adipiscens.

source: Finally, he perished completely.
target: Denique, omnino interiit.

source: What a formidable adversary to vanquish… If his wraith transformation hadn’t been halted, could he have endured as a true wraith, evolving into an evil spirit in the future?
target: Quam formidolosus adversarius ad superandum… Si forma umbratilis eius non esset sistita, potuissetne ut vera umbra diuturno tempore permaneret, in malum spiritum in posterum evolvens?

source: Lumian glanced at Hela beside him and spoke once more, “Thank you.”
target: Lumian ad Hela, quae iuxta eum stabat, respexit et denuo dixit: “Gratias tibi ago.”

source: He refrained from elaborating his conversation with Hisoka, recognizing that they had spoken in the dream created by Hela. She must be aware of it.
target: De colloquio suo cum Hisoka ampliando abstinuit, agnoscens eos in somnio a Hela creato locutos esse; illa id scire debet.

source: “Loki is the only one left,” Hela said coldly, her gaze fixed on Hisoka’s lifeless form.
target: “Loki solus restant,” inquit Hela frigide, oculis in formam inanimatam Hisokae intentis.

source: Lumian fell silent for a few seconds before stating, “He can’t be resurrected more than a few times.”
target: Lumian paucos momenta silentium tulit antequam dixit: “Non potest ultra paucos vicibus resurrectus esse.”

source: “At most one more time,” Hela replied with certainty.
target: “Maxime semel amplius,” respondit Hela certo.

source: Another time… Lumian tersely acknowledged.
target: Altera vice… Lumian breviter adsentivit.

source: Before long, Hisoka’s Beyonder characteristic manifested, blending with the remaining goat horns above his head, transforming into a whimsical and flamboyant cluster of black crystals.
target: Mox proprietas Beyonder Hisokae manifestata est, cum reliqua cornua caprina supra caput eius miscebatur, in conglobatum nigriorum crystallorum lepidum ac pomposum transformans.

source: Various crystals extended in all directions, sharp and crooked.
target: Varii cristalli in omnes partes se extendebant, acuti et incurvi.

source: Multiple illusory, translucent faces emerged from each black crystal, their expressions alternating between malevolence, pain, madness, and confusion.
target: Plures facies illusoriae translucidae ex unoquoque cristallo nigro emergere coeperunt, quorum vultus inter malitiam, dolorem, insanitatem, atque confusionem alternabantur.

source: A Desire Apostle Beyonder characteristic corrupted by a Wraith boon? Lumian perceived it as more corrupting and perilous than the Serial Killer Beyonder characteristic from before.
target: Proprietas Beyonder Apostoli Desiderii, beneficio umbratili corrupta? Lumian id percepit ut magis corrumpens et periculosus esset quam proprietas Beyonder Serialis Homicidarum antea.

source: He pointed at the Beyonder characteristic and Hisoka’s lifeless body, addressing Hela, “Can I take them all?”
target: Ille monstravit proprietatem Beyonder et corpus inanimatum Hisokae, ad Hela loquens: “Possumne omnia sumere?”

source: “Okay,” Hela responded without objections.
target: “Ita,” respondit Hela sine objectione.

source: In an old warehouse on an abandoned dock in Port Pylos, Franca, Anthony, and Jenna had already gathered, awaiting Lumian’s return.
target: In veteri horreo super derelicto pontili in Portu Pylos, Franca, Anthony, et Jenna iam convenerant, reditum Lumiani exspectantes.

source: Amidst their conversation, a figure outlined itself in the sunlight streaming through a high window.
target: Inter sermonem eorum, figura se delineavit in lumine solis per altam fenestram decurrente.

source: It was Lumian, wearing a golden straw hat and disguised as Louis Berry.
target: Erat Lumian, galeam stramineam auream indutus et se quasi Louis Berry simulans.

source: Pa!
target: Pa!

source: Lumian tossed Hisoka’s corpse to the ground.
target: Lumian cadaver Hisokae in terram proiecit.

source: Immediately after, he retrieved the Beyonder characteristic from his Traveler’s Bag and placed them near the corpse without touching them.
target: Statim post, proprietatem Beyonder de sacculo Viatoris sui extraxit et prope cadaver posuit, ea non tetigens.

source: Only then did he smile at Franca, Jenna, and Anthony.
target: Tum demum Francae, Jennae, et Anthony subrisit.

source: “It’s settled.”
target: “Consensum est.”

source: “Is it really Hisoka?” Franca couldn’t believe it could be so straightforward.
target: “Num vere Hisoka?” Franca non potuit credere id tam simpliciter evenire.

source: “It’s him,” Lumian briefly explained the situation. “He was overconfident and believed there’s a high chance of killing me. He chose to stay and wait for an opportunity.”
target: “Is ille,” Lumian breviter exponit, “superconfidens fuit et creditur mihi interficere posse. Manere et occasionem exspectare elegit.”

source: “What gave him the confidence?” Franca’s eyes widened.
target: “Quid ei confidentiam dedit?” Francae oculi dilatati sunt.

source: Since everyone present held a Minor Arcana card, Lumian didn’t hold anything back.
target: Quoniam omnes praesentes chartas Minoris Arcanae haberent, Lumian nihil retinuit.

source: He recounted the situation, omitting the most perilous details.
target: Res enarravit, singularia gravissima omittens.

source: “Can that really happen… Luckily, you didn’t seek guidance from the Tarot Club.” Jenna felt a lingering fear.
target: “Num vere tale fieri possit… Feliciter, non a Tarot Club consilium petivisti.” Jenna diuturnum timorem sensit.

source: Franca sighed and commented, “I didn’t think our collaboration alone would be sufficient.”
target: Franca suspiravit et dixit, “Non putavi solam nostram collaborationem sufficere.”

source: Lumian pointed at the Beyonder characteristic and stated, “There’s too much corruption, and it’s very dangerous. I plan to seek Madam Magician’s help and find a suitable Artisan to transform it into a Sealed Artifact. Everyone has the right to use it.”
target: Lumian monstravit proprietatem Beyonder et dixit, “Nimis multum corruptio est, et periculosum est. Consilium habeo auxilium Dominae Magicae petendi et artificem idoneum inveniendi, ut in artifactum sigillatum transformetur. Omnes ius habent id uti.”

source: Lumian found it too sinister and corrupting. It couldn’t become a mystical item with relatively mild negative effects. It could only be the kind that required sealing.
target: Lumian id nimis sinistrum et corrumpentem invenit. Non potuit fieri res mystica cum effectibus relativis levibus negativis. Tantum esse potuit genus quod sigillandum esset.

source: “Absolutely.” Franca was filled with anticipation as she imagined the potential abilities of a Sealed Artifact.
target: “Prorsus.” Franca anticipatione plena erat, dum potentias artifacti sigillati repraesentare conabatur.

source: She suddenly recalled something and quickly blurted out, “Your Pride Armor is still in my possession. Tsk, you’ve really gotten the most out of it.”
target: Subito aliquid recordatus est et celeriter exclamat, “Tua Armatura Superbiae adhuc in mea possessione est. Hem, vere ex ea maximam utilitatem tulisti.”

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian risit.

source: “How can I face Devils without a Warrior? I’ve always wanted to use the Pride Armor, but I didn’t expect Hisoka to choose the most convenient place like the bathroom.”
target: “Quomodo Diabolos occurrere possum sine Bello? Semper volui Armaturam Superbiae uti, sed non exspectavi Hisokam locum commodissimum tamquam latrinam eligere.”

source: It was a confined, tight space with a certain degree of flexibility.
target: Erat spatium confinatum et arctum, cum aliquo gradu flexibilitatis.

source: Franca retrieved the Pride Armor from her Traveler’s Bag and placed it on the ground.
target: Franca Armaturam Superbiae e sacculo Viatoris extraxit et in terram posuit.

source: Suddenly, the air in the old warehouse froze.
target: Subito, aer in veteri horreo congelatus est.

source: The silver-white full-body armor turned to face Lumian, condensing into a broadsword of light.
target: Armatura integra argenteo-alba ad Lumian versa, in gladium lucis latiorem condensata est.

source: Then, it knelt on one knee and thrust into the ground.
target: Deinde, in uno genu flecta, in terram impulsa est.

source: Wh— Lumian’s pupils dilated as his figure abruptly faded, disappearing from his spot.
target: Heu— Pupillae Lumiani dilatatae sunt, cum figura eius repente evanuit, ab ipso loco disparens.

source: The broadsword of light split open, transforming into a devastating storm that engulfed the surroundings, obliterating numerous wooden crates.
target: Gladius lati lucis discidit, atque in tempestatem perniciosam transformatus est, quae circumiecta complectitus est, et multas arcas ligneas delebat.

source: Wh— Franca, Jenna, and Anthony couldn’t dodge in time and were shattered into fragments by the Hurricane of Light, reflecting brilliance.
target: Heu— Franca, Jenna, et Anthony non potuerunt opportune evadere et a Turbo Lucis, splendore micante, in fragmenta disiecti sunt.

source: “Dammit! Isn’t this too vengeful? How much time has passed?!” Franca cursed from a corner of the warehouse.
target: “Heu! Nonne hoc nimis ulterius vindictivum est? Quam tempus praeteriit?!” Franca ex angulo horrei maledicta est.
